message_pattern:
Scan with ID= state changed from to | URL set with ID= state changed from to | job with id: , changed state to: and phase

| Changed scan state from to (scrape-server)
dataprime: source logs | filter $d.context.property_id == '<LAST12_OF_PROPERTY_ID>' | filter $d.logger_name ~ 'ScanService|JobService|JobPoller|JobScheduler|UrlSetService|JobMessageListener|AppCommunicatorUtils|Export|Email' || $m.severity == WARNING || $m.severity == ERROR | choose $m.timestamp, $l.subsystemname, $d.logger_name, $d.context.scan_id, $d.context.job_id, $d.error.message, substr($d.message:string,0,250) as msg | orderby $m.timestamp asc
volume: ~20-40 lines per scan job; window = ticket date +-1 day
noise: Info lifecycle lines; not an error signature itself. Use to see where the chain stopped.
notes: IDs in $d.context are truncated to last 12 hex chars of the UUID. Context propagates into scrape-server (dispatch, k8s job creation, polling). templateid unstable for these services; use logger_name+regex.

message_pattern: for property: <propertyId>, the next schedule job time is: <yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm>
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.message ~ 'the next schedule job time is' && $d.message ~ '<PROPERTY_UUID>' | choose $m.timestamp, $l.subsystemname, $d.message | orderby $m.timestamp asc
key_fields: next run time (in text, no timezone)
noise: Info. Signal when next time is wrong vs customer's configured schedule/timezone or not logged at all.
notes: Compare to property schedule settings; times appear local-naive (no zone) - a timezone bug shows as an offset.

message_pattern: failed to create entity for property with id: <propertyId>. continuing to the next property
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.message ~ 'failed to create entity for property' | groupby $d.error.type, substr($d.error.message:string,0,120) as emsg aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.property_id) as props | orderby n desc
volume: ~24k/day total (2026-11-02), repeats every scheduler cycle per property
noise: Mostly chronic background (expired licences, empty URL sets). Signal only when the ticket's property appears; the error.message gives the reason.
notes: error.message values: 'The license has expired...' (LimitExceededException ~15k/day, E4); 'No URLs were supplied' / 'Property URL set is not defined' / 'Scan must have at least one URL' (config/0 URLs); 'The time the runner waits before it starts must be less than 30 seconds' (settings validation); 'property not found for propertyId' (orphan schedule).

message_pattern: $d.error.type == com.evinced.common.exception.LimitExceededException; messages 'The license has expired...' / 'No license exists. Please create a trial license...'
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.error.type ~ 'LimitExceededException' | groupby $d.context.tenant_name, substr($d.error.message:string,0,100) as emsg aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.property_id) as props | orderby n desc
noise: Chronic for expired tenants. Signal = ticket's tenant appears / a new tenant starts appearing.
notes: Concurrent-scan limit messages not observed in sample day; group by emsg to spot other limit types.

message_pattern: Failed running create crawl request for URL set with ID=<urlSetId>
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.message ~ 'Failed running create crawl request' | choose $m.timestamp, $l.subsystemname, $d.context.tenant_name, $d.context.property_id, $d.context.client, $d.context.job_time, $d.error.type, $d.error.message
noise: Low volume -> each one is meaningful. error.message 'Job failed due to timeout/failure' (JobPoller.onTimedOut) = job timed out after ~24h, vs connection/HTTP errors = real dispatch refusal.
notes: Followed by JobService 'job with id: X, changed state to: FAILED and phase FAILED'.

message_pattern: job with id: <id>, changed state to: FAILED and phase FAILED | Scan with ID=<id> state changed from RUNNING to FAILED
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && ($d.message ~ 'changed state to: FAILED' || $d.message ~ 'state changed from \\w+ to FAILED') | groupby $d.context.tenant_name, $l.subsystemname aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.message:string) as sample | orderby n desc
noise: Low volume; every hit is a failed run. Look at ERRORs with same $d.context.job_id just before.

message_pattern: ERROR: duplicate key ... violates unique constraint "key_type_constraint" Detail: Key ...=(<propertyId><jobId><yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm>, JobEntity) already exists.
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.message ~ 'JobEntity\\) already exists' | extract $d.message into $d.dk using regexp(e=/=\((?<ids>[0-9a-f-]{72})(?<runat>\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d), JobEntity/) | groupby $l.subsystemname, $d.dk.ids, $d.dk.runat aggregate count() as n, min($m.timestamp) as first | orderby n desc
noise: runAt == current slot -> benign race between admin-server and front-server schedulers. runAt in the past and repeating every 7.5 min -> STUCK schedule (property never runs again).
notes: Accompanied by 'SQL Error: 0, SQLState: 23505' and 'Application exception overridden by commit exception' (JsonMappingException on UrlSetDiscoveryConfigurationEntity). Stuck keys seen: runAt 2025-07-21..2026-02-15 on site-scanner webapps.

message_pattern: invocation of function (<Controller>.<method>) took <N> millis.  (WARNING when > ~10s)
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'front-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.c.l.f.FunctionLogger' && ($d.message ~ 'ViewsController' || $d.message ~ 'ScanController' || $d.message ~ 'ScanPagesController' || $d.message ~ 'ScanIssuesController' || $d.message ~ 'PropertyOverview') | extract $d.message into $d.fx using regexp(e=/\((?<fn>[A-Za-z]+\.[A-Za-z]+)\) (?<what>took|failed)/) | extract $d.message into $d.fm using regexp(e=/(?<ms>[0-9]+) millis/) | groupby $d.fx.fn, $d.fx.what, $m.severity, $d.context.tenant_name aggregate count() as n, avg($d.fm.ms:number) as avgms, max($d.fm.ms:number) as mx | orderby mx desc
volume: 6h: ScanController.list 5.5k calls (23 WARN, max 50s); ScanPages/ScanIssues.overview ~16 WARN each (max ~20s)
noise: Info lines are normal traffic; WARNING (>10s) rows for the ticket's tenant/scan are the 'Error loading scan' backend-timeout signal.
notes: If many tenants show WARN in the same hour -> E1. Also ProductExportService.checkReportExists ~16-32s (export page).

message_pattern: invocation of function (X.y) failed (<Exception>:<msg>) after N millis | controller rejected request with client error | controller request failed with server error | An internal error occurred and the response is altered to the default error message
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'front-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.c.web.api.RestExceptionHandler' | groupby $d.message as kind, $d.error.type, substr($d.context.request_uri:string,0,40) as uri aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.tenant_id) as tenants, any_value(substr($d.error.message:string,0,100)) as emsg | orderby n desc
noise: 4xx 'Service account not found' on /api/service-accounts is chronic (2 SAs). 5xx are rare and meaningful.
notes: Seen: NPE in PagesEnricherStrategy on /api/property-overview (one tenant, dashboard fails); NotFound 'Scan could not be found' / 'could not find view' / 'Property could not be found' (deleted scan/view/property -> E5 scan_deleted_not_found).

where: admin-webapp, front-webapp, admin-server, front-server (ScanResultExportService / ScanResultExportPoller / PollTaskRunnerService)
message_pattern: failed to generate (CSV|XLSX) for scan <scanId> for owner <ownerId> \((poller timeout|poll request failed)\) | Failed handling sample failure of SCAN_RESULT_EXPORT task with ID=<id> - this reflects a ScanResultExportPoller.onFailed() bug | poll request failed - will retry at next poll interval
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && matches($d.message:string, /failed to generate (CSV|XLSX)|SCAN_RESULT_EXPORT|ExportIssues|exportIssues/) | extract $d.message into $d.ex using regexp(e=/generate (?<fmt>CSV|XLSX) for scan (?<scan>[0-9a-f-]{36}).*\((?<why>[^)]+)\)/) | groupby $d.ex.fmt, $d.ex.scan, $d.ex.why, $d.error.message aggregate count() as n | orderby n desc
noise: One stuck owner/scan can loop for days. Signal = ticket's scanId. ConflictException 'Export for this scan and filter already running' = user double-click.
notes: Error 'Scan <id> not found' -> export of deleted scan. ScanResultExportPoller.onFailed() bug -> failure never surfaced to user.

message_pattern: publish to queue <id>-csv failed (attempt N): Connection refused. retrying in Nms | Could not publish message to queue: <id>-csv after 12 attempts / 120000ms
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'front-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.p.c.s.c.CsvGenerationRabbitCommunicator' | groupby $l.subsystemname, roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h) as hour aggregate count() as n, any_value(substr($d.message:string,0,160)) as sample
noise: Any occurrence = RabbitMQ unreachable; exports during that window not generated.

message_pattern: Failed to send (crawl|scan) completion email for (urlSetId|scanId)=<id> | CrawlCompletionEmailListener failed processing URL set state changed (RUNNING -> DONE) event
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && matches($d.message:string, /Failed to send (crawl|scan) completion email|CompletionEmailListener.*failed processing/) | groupby $d.logger_name, $d.error.type, substr($d.error.message:string,0,120) as emsg aggregate count() as n, distinct_count($d.context.tenant_id) as tenants
noise: NotFoundException "Didn't find property P for mail to user U" = deleted property (benign). NoHttpResponseException 'api.sendgrid.com:443 failed to respond' = SendGrid outage (real).
notes: Absence of these lines + customer says no email -> spam/quarantine on customer side.

message_pattern: An invalid request caller ID was received: MCP
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'front-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && ($d.message ~ 'invalid request caller ID' || $d.message ~ 'TokenController.generateAccessToken') | groupby $d.message, $d.error.type aggregate count() as n
noise: Warning on every MCP request using that header; signal when correlated with MCP auth complaints. Token generation failures: 'Service account not found', LimitExceededException 'No license exists'.
notes: Jira/ADO have NO server-side log lines in scope.

message_pattern: kubernetes job failed - see job for more details Job(... name=<scanId> ... reason=BackoffLimitExceeded ...) | kubernetes job is in an unknown state Job(...)
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server' || $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-webapp') && $d.logger_name == 'c.e.c.k.t.KubernetesJobStateTransformer' | extract $d.message into $d.k using regexp(e=/name=(?<jobname>[0-9a-f-]{36}).*?reason=(?<reason>[A-Za-z]+)/) | groupby $m.severity, $d.k.reason, $d.context.tenant_name aggregate count() as n, any_value($d.k.jobname) as scan
noise: Rare; each is a real worker-pool failure. Many in one hour across tenants -> E1.
notes: Also check scrape-server 'polling scan with id S. Kubernetes job state: {... failedPodsCount: N}'.

message_pattern: Sampling scan with ID=<scanId> for its status passed its timeout, marking it as FAILED
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'admin-webapp' || $l.subsystemname == 'front-webapp') && $d.message ~ 'passed its timeout, marking it as FAILED' | choose $m.timestamp, $l.subsystemname, $d.context.tenant_name, $d.context.property_id, $d.message
noise: Every hit is a stuck scan that was force-failed.
notes: Look back for k8s_job_failed / 'Scan ingesting state for S not found' for the same scan.

message_pattern: (aggregate) distinct tenants with ERROR per hour, chronic noise excluded
dataprime: source logs | filter ($l.applicationname == 'admin' || $l.applicationname == 'front' || $l.subsystemname == 'scrape-server') && ($m.severity == ERROR || $m.severity == CRITICAL) | create $d.txt from firstNonNull($d.message:string, $d.body:string) | filter !($d.txt ~ 'failed to create entity for property') && !($d.txt ~ 'duplicate key') && !($d.txt ~ 'SQLState') && !($d.txt ~ 'overridden by commit') && !($d.txt ~ 'service-accounts') | extract $d.txt into $d.mdc using regexp(e=/tenancyName=(?<tenant>[^\]]+)\]/) | groupby roundTime($m.timestamp, 1h) as hour aggregate count() as errors, distinct_count(firstNonNull($d.context.tenant_name:string, $d.mdc.tenant:string)) as tenants, any_value(substr($d.txt,0,200)) as sample | orderby hour asc
noise: Raw error count is flat (chronic noise); use distinct tenants. Threshold ~3x 24h median and >=8.
notes: Works on both old ($d.body text MDC, June 2026) and new ($d.message + $d.context) schemas.
